seo.heading: The fastest way to save Instagram Reels
paragraphs: Instagram doesn't give you a built-in way to save someone else's Reel to your camera roll. Our tool solves that in one paste: drop in the link, and we pull the original MP4 file directly from Instagram's servers so you get a clean, watermark-free copy in the same quality it was uploaded in.

It works entirely in your browser — there's nothing to install, no account to create, and no personal data required. Just the public link to the Reel you want. That makes it safe to use on any device, whether you're on a phone between classes or at a desktop editing a compilation.

Creators use it to archive their own content before it disappears from trending feeds, marketers use it to build swipe files of ad creative, and everyday users use it to keep a copy of a Reel a friend sent them before it gets deleted. Whatever the reason, the flow stays the same: paste, preview, download.

items.q: Is this Reels downloader really free?
items.a: Yes. There's no subscription, no watermark added, and no limit tied to an account, since no account is needed at all.

items.q: Do I need to log in to my Instagram account?
items.a: No. You only need the public link to the Reel. We never ask for your Instagram username or password.
No. This tool only works on public Reels, since private content is intentionally restricted by Instagram and isn't accessible via a shared link.

items.q: What video quality do I get?
items.a: You get the original resolution the creator uploaded, typically HD, with no re-compression or added branding.

items.q: Is it legal to download Reels?
items.a: Downloading for personal, offline viewing is generally fine, but re-uploading someone else's content without permission can violate copyright and Instagram's terms. Always credit the original creator.

items.q: Does this work on iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes, it runs in any modern mobile or desktop browser without needing an app install.

sections.heading: Overview
body: SaveReelsFast (savereelsfast.com) is a free tool for saving publicly available Instagram Reels. You do not need an account, and we never ask for your Instagram username or password. This policy explains what limited information is processed when you use the site.

sections.heading: Information we process
body: Links you submit: when you paste a Reel link, it is sent to our server so we can look up the public video. We do not keep the link or the video once the request is finished.
Technical data: like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically record your IP address, browser type, and the time of each request for security and reliability purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We use one functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember the language you choose. It contains no personal information.
If we display advertising in the future, our advertising partners may set their own cookies. Where the law requires it, we will ask for your consent before non-essential cookies are used.

sections.heading: How we use information
body: We use the information above only to operate the service, keep it secure, prevent abuse, and understand overall performance. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Third parties
body: Videos are retrieved from Instagram's public servers. We are not affiliated with Instagram or Meta, and their own privacy policies apply to their services. Our site is hosted by a third-party provider that processes technical data on our behalf.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or to object to its processing. To make a request, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

sections.heading: Children
body: This service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
